title: Nintendo’s next Fire Emblem has a bold new structure
summary: Nintendo's new Fire Emblem game for Switch 2, Fortune's Weave, allows players to swap between four heroes and pursue multiple storylines simultaneously, addressing a longstanding limitation of Three Houses where players typically experienced only one faction's story per playthrough. This structural shift aims to let players see all character narratives in a single run.
content:
Nintendo's first Fire Emblem game for the Switch 2 is structured in an ambitious way. Unlike the well-loved Three Houses, a strategy game that tasked you with pledging allegiance to a specific faction and seeing their story all the way to the end, the new Fortune's Weave lets you swap between four heroes and their compatriots so you can tackle multiple storylines at once. With Three Houses, I only ever played one path and never went back to experience the others. I hoped that the new game's structure would be a way to see everyone's stories in one playthrough.

zh.title: 任天堂下一款《火焰纹章》采用大胆的新结构
zh.summary: 任天堂为Switch 2推出的新作《火焰纹章 财富之织》允许玩家在四位英雄之间切换并同时推进多条故事线，解决了《三战士》中的长期限制——玩家通常只能在每次游戏中体验一个派系的故事。这种结构性转变旨在让玩家在一次运行中体验所有角色的叙事。

title: Flock CEO: ‘We got this one wrong’
summary: Surveillance tech company Flock is implementing updates to prevent law enforcement abuse of its tools, including instances where officers used the system to stalk ex-partners. CEO Garrett Langley acknowledged the company's responsibility, and new features like Audit Assistance will flag abnormal search behavior and lock out suspicious users pending administrator review.
content:
Surveillance tech company Flock is rolling out updates to address reports of cops across the country abusing its tools to stalk ex-romantic partners and others. CEO Garrett Langley is delivering a mea culpa, and in an interview with The Verge, says he's changed his mind on what responsibility Flock bears for how law enforcement uses it.
Over the coming weeks, Flock will begin implementing updates that include requiring a previously optional feature called Audit Assistance, which flags "abnormal search behavior" and immediately locks out suspicious users until an administrator reviews their activity. title: Claude's new Scarlet Letter watermark is invisible — for now
summary: Anthropic has implemented an invisible watermark system for Claude that flags all content Claude has processed or edited, serving as a detector for AI involvement in writing. The technology marks both original AI-generated content and human writing that has been modified by Claude.
content: The mark flags anything Claude processed, even human writing it only edited.

zh.title: Claude的新"红字"水印目前是隐形的
zh.summary: Anthropic为Claude实施了一个隐形水印系统，标记Claude处理或编辑过的所有内容，作为检测写作中AI参与的方式。该技术会标记原始的AI生成内容和被Claude修改过的人类写作。
